# Design system atoms

Unmodified copies from `jvanheerikhuize/asdlc-meta-designsystem` at commit
`9d3a5457ffa2a2b5b8498c07ff950e61f1852f64` (v0.3.1 catalog), MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`).

They are bundled rather than loaded from GitHub Pages so the app works without internet access and
never runs remote code. To update, replace the `ui-*.js` files with `src/atoms/` from a newer commit
and change the commit above. App code uses them through `src/components/ds.tsx`.
